findings.problem: Testigo has common gender (el testigo for a man, la testigo for a woman), so listing it as only masculine is misleading, and the example's la única testigo seems to contradict it.
findings.fix: grammar: gender m/f (common gender), article el / la (el testigo, la testigo)

back.es: witness (a person who sees an event or testifies)
back.example: She is the only witness of the accident.

note: Keeping es as el testigo is fine as the dictionary form, but the grammar should teach the learner that the article follows the person's sex.
